description: Dataform is a framework for managing SQL based data operations in BigQuery

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: add BigQuery property graphs user guide (docs/property_graphs.md) by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2422
* feat(cli): generate the CLI reference tables in cli/README.md from the option definitions by @mbiernacik in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2419
* feat(cli)!: allow --json to be used without --dry-run in run by @Ford544 in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2418
* feat(cli): make location optional in init and init-creds by @Ford544 in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2402
* Add warning if set @@dataset_id used with no defaultLocation by @Ford544 in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2421
* fix(cli): attach ClientInfo gRPC metadata header to lineage run events by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2425
* chore(cli): address review comments from #2425 on lineage ClientInfo header by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2429
* Bump DF_VERSION from 3.1.4 to 3.1.5 by @rafal-hawrylak in https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/pull/2430


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dataform-co/dataform/compare/3.1.4...3.1.5
